_comment: Worked, abbreviated example of the normalized JSON that scripts/build_reconciliation_workbook.py consumes. Real inputs have the full eVar/prop/event lists. Shows every section: reportSuite (defined), mapping (populated), noopElements, statusOverrides (ECID/audio the mapping can't infer), elements (reverse view + orphans), issues, recommendations.

meta.subtitle: Report suite variables mapped to the new Web SDK property's data elements — what is collecting data, what is not wired up, and open data issues.
meta.bottomLine: Migration is at full parity — every variable the old property populated, the new build populates. The non-green rows are report-suite definitions the old property never used (client decisions), not migration gaps.

14.note: ECID — Web SDK manages identity natively; not captured into an eVar. Source element was a broken recursive stub.

26.note: Duplicate label of eVar9 (populated). Unused report-suite duplicate.

51.note: AUDIO — defined in the report suite but never built in the old property. Net-new scope (Web SDK media collection).

4.note: Filtered out of the page view (valued event fed by a no-op counter) — deferred with Internal Campaign.

35.note: AUDIO event — never implemented in the old property.

elements.name: Campaign: Internal

issues.description: A full audio feature is defined in the report suite but was never implemented in the old property.
issues.recommendation: Net-new scope if wanted (Web SDK media collection). Scope + estimate separately.

issues.recommendation: No action — correct Web SDK design.
